title: DoorDash app and website outage, Nov 21, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by DoorDash, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: DoorDash is a food-delivery service that many people use daily, and Downdetector logged more than 12,700 reports. DoorDash has not said how many customers were affected, and Downdetector counts reports, not users.
who_is_affected: People who use the DoorDash app or website, mostly in the US, from about 11 AM ET on Saturday, Nov 21, and businesses using DoorDash Drive from 11:30 AM ET. When the problem fully ended is not confirmed.

known.text: DoorDash's status page showed an increase in errors on its Drive endpoints from 11:30 AM ET on Nov 21 and a recovery update at 11:50 AM ET, per two outlets relaying it.

not_known.text: What caused the outage. DoorDash has not said.
Whether it was a cyberattack. DoorDash has not said either way; the hack idea is only social-media speculation.
Whether the Drive incident caused the app and website errors, and when the problem ended. Components showed operational by 1:52 PM ET, but neither incident was marked resolved.
